component.name: Mobile/Top Navigation
component.description: Primary top navigation bar providing global access points and contextual navigation. 8 levels/states cover home, sub-pages, deep pages, onboarding, logged-in user states, progress steps, alerts, and end-to-end flows.

purpose.Level 1: Primary navigation anchor — global access points and app identity. Bottom Nav visible.
purpose.Level 2: Contextual navigation within a specific flow or section. Bottom Nav hidden.
purpose.Level 3: Deep/granular pages (settings, details, preferences). Minimal distraction.
purpose.User logged in: Logged-in user state with profile access
purpose.W Progress Steps: Navigation with inline progress steps indicator

notes: Content on Hover or Focus Level AA

considerations: Level 1 pages show Bottom Nav; Level 2 and Level 3 pages hide it
Back button appears on Level 2+ pages
Up to 3 CTAs can be shown in the trailing section

component.name: Alert
component.description: Alert banner within top nav showing contextual status messages (payment received, steps progress, etc.).

navigationLevels.Level 1: Home / Main tabs — Bottom Nav visible
navigationLevels.Level 2: Sub-pages within a section — Bottom Nav hidden
